extDescription.message: Opens in Thunderbird the mails prepared in Organizer, with their attachments, keeps the conversations up to date and brings incoming mail into Organizer.

optIntro.message: Connect Thunderbird to Organizer: "Send" will open the mails here, and sent mails and incoming replies update by themselves in Organizer.

optTokenHelp.message: Create it in Organizer: Settings → Mail and Thunderbird → "Create token for Thunderbird".

optInbox.message: Pass all incoming mail to Organizer

optInboxHelp.message: So in Organizer (Mail → Inbox) you see the mails you received and reply from there. Only you see them. Off, only the replies to mails sent from Organizer reach Organizer.

optAccountsHelp.message: An account's new conversations end up in its Organizer workspace. Those already in Organizer stay where they are (a topic is moved from its page, ⋯ menu).

optBadAddress.message: Invalid address: write for example https://organizer.example.com

optNoPermission.message: Without the permission to connect to that address the extension cannot work.

stEnterConfig.message: Enter address and token in the options

stBadToken.message: Invalid or revoked token: create a new one in Organizer

ntSentUnknown.message: Mail sent, but Organizer did not hear about it: $1

errNoFolder.message: it is not in any Thunderbird folder

stBackfill.message: Loading the last month's mails into Organizer…

stBackfillN.message: Loading the last month's mails into Organizer… $1/$2

ntBackfillDone.message: Last month's mails loaded into Organizer ($1)

stBackfillFail.message: Loading the last month interrupted ($1): retrying at the next connection
